4141704edcb2e98ada19d8e46c24380c5d478d73.sourceText:
| 方向 | 数据 | 代码实际用途 |
|---|---|---|
| 读取文件 | `prior_pcd_file` | 加载PCD，启动时变换、降采样，建立固定目标地图 |
| 订阅 | `registered_scan`，可由input_cloud_topic更名 | 复制XYZ坐标并累加多帧，作为本轮匹配点云；不用反射强度或点内时间 |
| 订阅 | `initialpose`，PoseWithCovarianceStamped | 用人工给定的位姿重设匹配初值；话题名写死为相对名 |
| 广播 | `map → odom` | 发布点云匹配得到的参考系修正；不发布独立位姿或匹配点云话题 |
4141704edcb2e98ada19d8e46c24380c5d478d73.translatedText:
| Direction | Data | Actual code purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Read file | `prior_pcd_file` | Load PCD, transform at startup, downsample, build fixed target map |
| Subscribe | `registered_scan`，renamable by input_cloud_topic | Copy XYZ coordinates and accumulate multiple frames as the matching point cloud for this round; do not use reflection intensity or per\-point time |
| Subscribe | `initialpose`，PoseWithCovarianceStamped | Reset the initial matching value using a manually given pose; the topic name is hardcoded as a relative name |
| Broadcast | `map → odom` | Publish the reference frame correction obtained from point cloud matching; do not publish independent pose or matching point cloud topics |

414ba9a4b9f5f3d288f21eea4d0470e33b3f66fe.translatedText: When set to True, acceleration and angular velocity are used as prediction inputs, and after unit scaling and bias processing, they drive the motion state\. Switching the model also changes the noise parameters used, so for the first round, keep the current False\.

41a200c9829e5290a48696e7fd8c7f38482f64f3.sourceText: `clearingDis` 仅在清图事件触发后使用，清掉的是 `d < clearingDis` 的点。当前0没有正半径清除区；`joy` 的第6个按钮可触发清图，`map_clearing` 的 Float32 消息会覆盖清图半径并触发处理。原注释“该距离外的点会被清除”方向相反，不能照此理解。清图只影响本节点缓存，不是删除 Point-LIO 地图；本轮未发布任何清图消息。
41a200c9829e5290a48696e7fd8c7f38482f64f3.translatedText: `clearingDis` Only used after a clear\-map event is triggered; what gets cleared are the points of `d < clearingDis`\. Currently 0 has no positive\-radius clearing area; the 6th button of `joy` can trigger the clear map, and the Float32 message of `map_clearing` will override the clear\-map radius and trigger processing\. The original comment "points beyond this distance will be cleared" has the opposite direction and cannot be understood that way\. Clear map only affects the cache of this node, not deleting the Point-LIO map; no clear\-map message was published in this round\.
